title: lig50K recon - Tube based
body:
### 1. lig50K nucleosome recon (tube-based)

| Step | Action | Dilution buffer added at this step | Total liquid volume | Calculated salt |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | Completely dissolve the dried salt in 5 µL DNA | — | 5.000 µL | Approximately **2.00 M** |
| 2 | Add 0.954 µL working octamer; mix gently | — | **5.954 µL** | **1.840 M** |
| 3 | Initial equilibration using your previous 30-minute ice incubation | — | 5.954 µL | 1.840 M |
| 4 | Begin gradual dilution | **1.349 µL** | 7.303 µL | **1.500 M** |
| 5 | Continue dilution | **3.651 µL** | 10.954 µL | **1.000 M** |
| 6 | Continue dilution | **2.739 µL** | 13.693 µL | **0.800 M** |
| 7 | Continue dilution | **4.564 µL** | 18.257 µL | **0.600 M** |
| 8 | Continue dilution | **9.128 µL** | 27.385 µL | **0.400 M** |
| 9 | Reach the proposed first-pilot endpoint | **16.431 µL** | **43.816 µL** | **0.250 M** |
| 10 | Optional further dilution | **10.954 µL** | **54.770 µL** | **0.200 M** |
